AlphaGenome Finetuning Pipeline#

This section details the shell and SLURM scripts used to execute the AlphaGenome finetuning pipeline.

Nonzero-mean computation#

Script to compute the nonzero-track means per .bw file used for the AlphaGenome squashed scale data transformation.

src/AlphaGenome_finetuning/00_compute_nonzero_means_per_bw.sh#
 1#!/bin/bash
 2# ==============================================================================
 3# Code by Jakob Then
 4# 
 5# Purpose: Computes the mean of non-zero track values for BigWig (.bw) files, 
 6#          specifically restricted to canonical chromosomes (chr1-22, X, Y). 
 7#          Designed for AlphaGenome finetuning data preparation.
 8# Input:   $1 - Directory containing input .bw files
 9# Output:  $2 - CSV file capturing basename, non-zero mean, and full path
10# ==============================================================================
11
12# SLURM Configuration
13#SBATCH --job-name=bw_mean_calc
14#SBATCH --output=logs/bw_mean_%j.log
15#SBATCH --error=logs/bw_mean_%j.err
16#SBATCH --time=04:00:00          # Adjust depending on the total number of BigWig files
17#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1        # Sequential processing per file
18#SBATCH --mem=64G                # Allocated generously to load large chromosome arrays into memory safely
19#SBATCH --partition=bigmem       # Ensure this matches your specific cluster topology
20
21# Example usage:
22# sbatch 00_compute_nonzero_means_per_bw.sh input_data/AlphaGenome_Borzoi_input input_data/metadata/bw_nonzero_means.csv
23
24source /g/easybuild/x86_64/Rocky/8/haswell/software/Miniforge3/24.1.2-0/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
25#source env/initiate_alphagenome_ft_env.sh
26source /g/steinmetz/projects/variant2function_project/env/alphagenome_ft//initiate_alphagenome_ft_env.sh
27
28# Validate CLI arguments to prevent empty variable execution errors
29if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
30    echo "Usage: sbatch $0 <input_directory> <output_file.csv>"
31    exit 1
32fi
33
34INPUT_DIR="$1"
35OUTPUT_FILE="$2"
36
37echo "Starting job on $(date)"
38echo "Input directory: $INPUT_DIR"
39echo "Output file: $OUTPUT_FILE"
40
41echo "basename,nonzero_mean_canonical,full_path" > "$OUTPUT_FILE"
42
43# Iterate through all BigWig files in the target directory
44find "$INPUT_DIR" -type f -name "*.bw" | while read -r bw_file; do
45    
46    base_name=$(basename "$bw_file")
47    
48    # Calculate non-zero means using an inline Python script. 
49    nonzero_mean=$(python3 -c '
50import sys, pyBigWig, numpy as np
51
52# Restrict analysis strictly to canonical chromosomes to prevent skewed means from alt-contigs or unplaced scaffolds
53valid_chroms = set([f"chr{i}" for i in range(1, 23)] + ["chrX", "chrY"])
54
55try:
56    bw = pyBigWig.open(sys.argv[1])
57    total_sum = 0
58    total_count = 0
59    
60    for chrom, length in bw.chroms().items():
61        if chrom not in valid_chroms:
62            continue
63            
64        # Load chromosome values into a numpy array for fast, vectorized filtering
65        vals = bw.values(chrom, 0, length, numpy=True)
66        
67        # Filter out zeroes and NaN values (unmapped regions)
68        nz = vals[(vals != 0) & (~np.isnan(vals))]
69        
70        total_sum += nz.sum()
71        total_count += len(nz)
72        
73    mean_val = total_sum / total_count if total_count > 0 else "NaN"
74    print(mean_val)
75    bw.close()
76except Exception as e:
77    print("Error_Reading_File")
78' "$bw_file")
79
80    # Append results incrementally to prevent data loss if the SLURM job times out unexpectedly
81    echo "$base_name,$nonzero_mean,$bw_file" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
82    echo "Processed: $base_name"
83done
84
85conda deactivate
86echo "Job finished on $(date). Results saved to $OUTPUT_FILE"

Config file generation#

Creates a .yaml config file containg the head and track configureation for AlphaGenome finetuning.

src/AlphaGenome_finetuning/01_make_config_file.sh#
 1#!/bin/bash
 2# ==============================================================================
 3# Code by Jakob Then
 4# 
 5# Purpose: Wrapper script to execute the Python config generator for 
 6#          AlphaGenome finetuning. It feeds predefined paths and modality
 7#          lists into the Python parser to generate the final YAML.
 8# Input:   Hardcoded variables pointing to directories and metadata
 9# Output:  A formatted .yaml configuration file (e.g., test_config.yaml)
10# ==============================================================================
11
12# SLURM Configuration
13#SBATCH --job-name=make_config
14#SBATCH --output=logs/make_config_%j.log 
15#SBATCH --error=logs/make_config_%j.err
16#SBATCH --time=01:00:00          
17#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1        # Sequential processing per file
18#SBATCH --mem=16G                
19#SBATCH --partition=bigmem       # Ensure this matches your specific cluster topology
20
21# Setup core paths and variables
22TARGETS_CONFIG_PATH="configs/test_config.yaml"
23DATA_DIR="../../input_data/AlphaGenome_Borzoi_input"
24NONZERO_MEANS_PATH="../../input_data/bw_nonzero_means.csv"
25#folders in DATA_DIR
26MODALITIES=(
27    "multiome_RNA_3prime_bigwig_deduplicated" 
28    "multiome_ATAC_bigwig_deduplicated" 
29    "CutnTag_bigwig"
30)
31
32# Load conda environments
33source /g/easybuild/x86_64/Rocky/8/haswell/software/Miniforge3/24.1.2-0/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
34source env/initiate_alphagenome_ft_env.sh
35
36# Execute the Python config builder
37python ../utils/preprocessing/make_AG_input_config.py \
38    --data_dir "${DATA_DIR}" \
39    --config_prefix "${TARGETS_CONFIG_PATH}" \
40    --modality_folders "${MODALITIES[@]}" \
41    --norm_tag "_100M" \
42    --nonzero_means "${NONZERO_MEANS_PATH}"
43
44conda deactivate
